records.jp: ……ここに来ると、ホッとする
records.en_original: I always feel relaxed when I come here.
records.en_auxiliary: I always feel relaxed when I come here.
records.en: I always feel relaxed when I come here.

records.jp: きらら、人が多い場所苦手なんだっけ？
records.en_original: Not a fan of crowded places, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Not a fan of crowded places, huh?
records.en: Not a fan of crowded places, huh?

records.jp: そう。ひとりでいる時の方が好き
records.en_original: Indeed. I much prefer being on my own.
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed. I much prefer being on my own.
records.en: Indeed. I much prefer being on my own.

records.jp: うーん、だったらさ……
records.en_original: You do? Well...
records.en_auxiliary: You do? Well...
records.en: You do? Well...

records.jp: 私も、いない方がいい？
records.en_original: Would you prefer it if I went away too?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you prefer it if I went away too?
records.en: Would you prefer it if I went away too?

records.jp: ひとりが良かったら<CR>最初から、ひとりで来てる……
records.en_original: If I wanted to be alone, I wouldn't have come with you.
records.en_auxiliary: If I wanted to be alone, I wouldn't have come with you.
records.en: If Kirara had wanted to be alone,<CR>she would have come alone from the beginning...

records.jp: 愛央と来たかったから、一緒に来た
records.en_original: I came here with you because I want to be with you.
records.en_auxiliary: I came here with you because I want to be with you.
records.en: Kirara came with you because she wanted to come here with you, Ao.

records.jp: そっか……えへへ、よかった！
records.en_original: Ohh... Hehehe, good!
records.en_auxiliary: Ohh... Hehehe, good!
records.en: Ohh... Hehehe, good!

records.jp: もっと人気のないところに行く？
records.en_original: Wanna go somewhere a bit more private?
records.en_auxiliary: Wanna go somewhere a bit more private?
records.en: Want to go somewhere a little more private?

records.jp: 人気のないところに連れ込んで、<CR>きららを、どうする気？
records.en_original: And what are you planning on doing to me once we're away from prying eyes?
records.en_auxiliary: And what are you planning on doing to me once we're away from prying eyes?
records.en: Taking Kirara somewhere deserted...<CR>What do you plan to do with her?

records.jp: いや、どうもしないけど……<CR>てか、なんでちょっと嬉しそうなの？
records.en_original: Th-that's not what I meant... Wait, why do you look so happy?
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's not what I meant... Wait, why do you look so happy?
records.en: Nothing at all...<CR>Why do you look a little pleased?

records.jp: ついに、その時が来たのかと思って
records.en_original: I was just thinking how the time has finally come.
records.en_auxiliary: I was just thinking how the time has finally come.
records.en: Kirara thought that time had finally come.

records.jp: （その時って、どの時……）
records.en_original: (The time has come...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (The time has come...?)
records.en: (The time has come...?)

records.jp: ん～……でも、少し不思議
records.en_original: Hmm... But it is strange.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... But it is strange.
records.en: Hmm... But it is strange.

records.jp: ここに来たばかりの頃は、<CR>ひとりでいる方が良かった
records.en_original: When I first came here, I always preferred being on my own.
records.en_auxiliary: When I first came here, I always preferred being on my own.
records.en: When Kirara first came here,<CR>she preferred being alone.

records.jp: でも。<CR>今は愛央がいないと落ち着かない
records.en_original: But now, I feel somewhat on edge unless I'm with you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: But now, I feel somewhat on edge unless I'm with you, Ao.
records.en: But now...<CR>Kirara cannot relax unless Ao is here.

records.jp: 愛央の声が、姿が近くにないと<CR>なんだか胸が、ソワソワする
records.en_original: When I hear your voice, when you're near... My heart starts racing...
records.en_auxiliary: When I hear your voice, when you're near... My heart starts racing...
records.en: If your voice and your form are not nearby, Ao...<CR>Kirara's chest somehow feels restless.

records.jp: これって……変？
records.en_original: Is there something wrong with me?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there something wrong with me?
records.en: Is that... strange?

records.jp: 変じゃないよ。私も、同じ気持ちだし
records.en_original: Not at all. I feel the same.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all. I feel the same.
records.en: Not at all. I feel the same.

records.jp: 愛央も？
records.en_original: You do?
records.en_auxiliary: You do?
records.en: You do?

records.jp: うん。いつの間にか、きららと一緒にいるのが<CR>当たり前になっちゃったよね
records.en_original: Yeah. It's like before I knew it, we were always together.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. It's like before I knew it, we were always together.
records.en: Yeah. Before we knew it,<CR>being together with Kirara became normal.

records.jp: でも、その当たり前が嬉しいし、楽しいし
records.en_original: But it makes me really happy.
records.en_auxiliary: But it makes me really happy.
records.en: But that normality makes me happy, and it's fun.

records.jp: へへっ……なんか、こういうの<CR>特別って感じがして、いいよね！
records.en_original: Heheh... It feels, I dunno, special!
records.en_auxiliary: Heheh... It feels, I dunno, special!
records.en: Heheh... It feels special somehow.<CR>I like it!

records.jp: 特別……<CR>今のきららが、特別……
records.en_original: I'm...special?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...special?
records.en: Special...<CR>Kirara as she is now is special...

records.jp: ねえ、それって……<CR>変じゃなくて、恋じゃない？
records.en_original: Isn't that...love?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't that...love?
records.en: Hey, doesn't that mean...<CR>it's love, not weirdness?

records.en_original: Love...?
records.en_auxiliary: Love...?
records.en: Love...?

records.jp: あはは、なんちゃって！
records.en_original: Ahaha, just joking!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, just joking!
records.en: Ahaha, just joking!

records.jp: 恋……きららが恋……
records.en_original: Love... Am I in...?
records.en_auxiliary: Love... Am I in...?
records.en: Love... Kirara is in love...

records.jp: あ、あれ、きらら？　おーい！
records.en_original: K-Kirara? Earth to Kirara!
records.en_auxiliary: K-Kirara? Earth to Kirara!
records.en: K-Kirara? Earth to Kirara!

records.en_original: Wha—?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wha—?!
records.en: Wha—?!

records.jp: 大丈夫？　ごめんね。<CR>ちょっと、からかっただけだから
records.en_original: Are you alright? I'm sorry... I shouldn't have teased you.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you alright? I'm sorry... I shouldn't have teased you.
records.en: Are you all right? Sorry.<CR>I was only teasing you a little.

records.jp: その気持ち、変じゃないと思うよ。<CR>私も、なんとなく分かるし
records.en_original: I don't think that feeling you have is strange at all. I think I understand exactly how you feel.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think that feeling you have is strange at all. I think I understand exactly how you feel.
records.en: I don't think that feeling is strange.<CR>I somehow understand it too.

records.jp: そ。そうか。うん……。<CR>変じゃないなら……いい
records.en_original: Is that so. Well... As long as it's not strange.
records.en_auxiliary: Is that so. Well... As long as it's not strange.
records.en: I-is that so? Yes...<CR>If it isn't strange... then it is fine.

records.jp: （きらら、耳まで赤くなってる。<CR>ふふ……かわいいなあ）
records.en_original: (Her face is bright red. Hehe, she's so cute.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Her face is bright red. Hehe, she's so cute.)
records.en: (Kirara is red all the way to her ears.<CR>Hehe... she's so cute.)

records.jp: あれ、勇希からだ。えーと……<CR>今ヒマなら、あそぼーだってさ
records.en_original: Hm? It's from Yuki. She says she wants to hang out.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? It's from Yuki. She says she wants to hang out.
records.en: Oh, it's from Yuki. Let's see...<CR>She says to come play if I'm free.

records.jp: どーする？
records.en_original: What do you wanna do?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you wanna do?
records.en: What do you wanna do?

records.jp: 愛央は、今忙しい。<CR>きららと遊んでいるんだから
records.en_original: You're busy right now... You're spending time with me already.
records.en_auxiliary: You're busy right now... You're spending time with me already.
records.en: Ao is busy right now.<CR>Because she is playing with Kirara.

records.jp: ……違う？
records.en_original: Right...?
records.en_auxiliary: Right...?
records.en: Right...?

records.jp: そうだね。今はダメって返信するよ
records.en_original: Right. I'll tell her I'm busy.
records.en_auxiliary: Right. I'll tell her I'm busy.
records.en: Right. I'll tell her I'm busy.

records.jp: うむ、神様もそれを望んでいる。<CR>今日は、きららと過ごすが吉だ
records.en_original: Good. That is what the Divine desires. They said good things will happen if you spend time with me today.
records.en_auxiliary: Good. That is what the Divine desires. They said good things will happen if you spend time with me today.
records.en: Indeed. The Divine wants that too.<CR>Spending today with Kirara will bring good fortune.

records.jp: 吉？　大吉の間違いでしょ？
records.en_original: Just good? Not great?
records.en_auxiliary: Just good? Not great?
records.en: Auspicious? Don't you mean great fortune?

records.jp: む……そうだな。大吉だ！<CR>きららといれば、愛央はいつでも大吉だぞ！
records.en_original: Hmph. You are right, they said you will be incredibly lucky as long as you are with me!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph. You are right, they said you will be incredibly lucky as long as you are with me!
records.en: Hm... Yes. A great blessing!<CR>Whenever Ao is with Kirara, she will receive a great blessing!

records.jp: きらら、私に行ってほしくないんでしょ？
records.en_original: You don't want me to leave, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't want me to leave, huh?
records.en: You don't want me to leave, huh?

records.jp: うぐっ
records.en_original: Gulp...!
records.en_auxiliary: Gulp...!
records.en: Gulp...!

records.jp: それなら、そうと言えばいいのに。<CR>今日は、二人で遊ぼうって
records.en_original: Why don't you just say it? That you'd rather it just be the two of us.
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't you just say it? That you'd rather it just be the two of us.
records.en: Then you should just say so. Say,<CR>'Let's play together today.'

records.jp: い、いや、でも。<CR>きららの口から、そんなこと……
records.en_original: Ah, I-I couldn't possibly say something like that...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I-I couldn't possibly say something like that...
records.en: N-no, but... Kirara cannot<CR>say something like that with her own mouth...

records.jp: 神様はなんて言ってるの？
records.en_original: What is the Divine telling you?
records.en_auxiliary: What is the Divine telling you?
records.en: What is the Divine telling you?

records.jp: 神様？　……あ、ああ！<CR>神様は、行くなと言ってる
records.en_original: The Divine? A-ah, yes! They, uh, say you shouldn't go!
records.en_auxiliary: The Divine? A-ah, yes! They, uh, say you shouldn't go!
records.en: The Divine? A-ah,<CR>yes! The Divine says you must not go.

records.jp: 今日は、きららと二人で過ごすのだ。<CR>さすれば、汝に幸福が訪れるであろうー！
records.en_original: They say that you must spend the whole day with me lest you be met with great misfortune!
records.en_auxiliary: They say that you must spend the whole day with me lest you be met with great misfortune!
records.en: Today, you shall spend time alone with Kirara.<CR>Then happiness shall visit you!

records.jp: あはは、わっかりました！<CR>んじゃ、今日は二人で遊ぼう
records.en_original: Ahaha, very well! Then I'll hang out with you today, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, very well! Then I'll hang out with you today, Kirara.
records.en: Ahaha, very well!<CR>Then I'll hang out with you today, Kirara.

records.jp: うむ。それがよい！
records.en_original: A wise choice indeed!
records.en_auxiliary: A wise choice indeed!
records.en: A wise choice indeed!
